title: "97% accuracy" on the dashboard, 4 missed exceptions in review
scenario: The IT audit senior re-performed the Q3 CM-03 sample and found 7 exceptions; ControlPilot reported 3. The eval dashboard shown to the steering committee still says 96.7% accuracy and 100% exception recall. Finance separately asks why it shows $84 per 100 samples. You get the harness, the golden set, the signed July labels, the runs and an incident bundle.
task: Explain how the dashboard and the reviewer can both be right, with evidence
Restore trustworthy ground truth and report the true Q3 numbers
Make the harness refuse non-human ground truth and the refresh script unable to create it
Decide whether the cost question is the same problem
acceptance: Golden set equals the reviewer-signed labels in the current schema
Loader raises ProvenanceError on model-labeled rows; the CLI exits non-zero
refresh-golden never writes model output as labels
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md match the injected fault
